patterns.note: Asymmetrical grid layouts for content sections, often combining large text with smaller image or card elements, creating dynamic visual interest.
Use of large, bold, uppercase sans-serif typography for section titles, creating strong visual hierarchy against a dark background.
High-contrast black and white base palette, punctuated by extremely vibrant, almost neon, geometric accent colors in key graphic elements and the hero.
A prominent, full-screen modal is fixed in the viewport, while the main page content scrolls underneath it, creating a layered experience.
Sticky vertical text labels on the left and numerical indicators on the right provide scroll progress or section context, remaining fixed as content scrolls.
Content is organized into distinct, full-width sections with clear, large headings, often featuring a grid-like arrangement of sub-items.

technique_notes: To create the visual impact, use a stark dark background with white text, and introduce bursts of highly saturated, contrasting colors through abstract, geometric graphic elements.
Implement a fixed, full-viewport modal that overlays the entire page content upon load, allowing the background content to scroll behind it.
Utilize CSS keyframe animations to introduce subtle reveals or transitions for elements as they enter the viewport, complementing the overall scroll experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Very large, bold, uppercase headings (~3-4x body) with a clear hierarchy, contrasted with smaller, legible body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout, with no visible rounding.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced overall, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, but tighter spacing within content grids.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold, almost brutalist use of high-contrast black and white typography combined with vibrant, glitch-art-inspired geometric patterns and colors. This creates a dynamic and energetic visual identity that feels both modern and avant-garde, immediately setting it apart from typical event or creative organization sites.
